Precondition: Observation modality complete: at least one end has an array, so arrival or departure directions can be measured
Consequence when violated: Direction constraints unavailable; the arrival-direction vectors the criterion is built on cannot be observed and the FIM construction fails
Existing occupation: Wymeersch RIS Table I; Emenonye RIS limitations; Villaverde (theorem level)

Precondition: Paths resolvable in delay: delay difference exceeds $1/B$
Consequence when violated: Sub-tap paths form an ambiguity subspace whose Fisher information is zero

Precondition: Paths resolvable in angle: angular separation exceeds the array angular resolution
Consequence when violated: Angular merging, which is the angular-domain counterpart of A2
Existing occupation: joint with A2, in the P3 family

Precondition: Correspondence between paths and geometric features is known
Consequence when violated: Data association ambiguity; joint association and state estimation becomes necessary

Precondition: Nuisance parameters eliminated correctly (complex gain, clock offset, source spectrum)
Consequence when violated: Position information is inflated or truncated by a wrong elimination convention

Precondition: Anchor positions, array orientations and floor geometry known
Consequence when violated: Geometry prior error enters the position dimensions; the bound is inflated or saturates

Precondition: Noise statistics known and credible, usually assumed Gaussian
Consequence when violated: The derivation flexibility of the FIM and CRB no longer holds

Precondition: Asymptotics hold: enough snapshots and signal-to-noise ratio for the CRB to be attainable
Consequence when violated: Threshold effect; the CRB is not attainable at low signal-to-noise ratio

Precondition: Geometry non-degenerate: anchors not coplanar or collinear
Consequence when violated: Rank structure degenerates, yet rank and condition-number checks cannot see it

Precondition: Only local identifiability is required, or global ambiguity is excluded separately
Consequence when violated: Full column rank does not exclude discrete ambiguity; mirror and collinear solutions
